verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only manual region selection for Vercel Functions. The default is iad1, and regions can be set per project or per function via the dashboard, vercel.json, or the CLI. Nothing documents automatic compute placement near backend data sources, so this is an adjacent manual control, not the capability the story names.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency

citations.quote: You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
